fatal_blockers: None of the seven proposals specifies a complete polynomial-size factor, target, normalization, coefficient bound, and unrestricted soundness shell. Assertions that R, L, V, D, or S are handled are design intentions, while every proposal still lacks the C/X composition or dimension-growth theorem required for a polynomial gap.

Proposal 1 invokes integer-RIP without a theorem connecting lossless-expander support, PSD, exact equal-radius equations, and unrestricted signed deviations. Its SDP has no frozen Gram parameterization or scale normalization, and G32/G37 already show that compatible parity can remain exactly additive despite cross-copy terms.

Proposal 2 supplies no formula-to-complex construction or explicit augmentation target. Smith torsion does not lower-bound the Euclidean norm of an affine representative, and searching arbitrary tiny restriction matrices can find irrelevant torsion without distinguishing YES from NO instances.

Proposal 3 leaves the laminar rows and weights unspecified and searches only flows with at most four negative edges, not the unrestricted CVP shell. A local signed splice can cancel after a short interval and affect only logarithmically many laminar rows, so no polynomial excess follows from prefix discrepancy.

Proposal 4 is defeated algebraically by A/K. Applying the exact integral G13 coefficients to the lifted honest digit trees satisfies every linear carry equation; if honest trees have only O(d) support, the affine combination has at most a constant multiple of O(d) support rather than b^d malformed leaves.

Proposal 5 has no specified phase family or proof of exact cosphericity, DROP resistance, or propagation from a sparsely falsified clause. The stated coherence bound becomes nonpositive for large support unless p dominates the square of that support, and a p=17,29 test cannot discriminate the claimed asymptotic mechanism.

Proposal 6 requires multiplication of coefficient-dependent residuals, which is nonlinear and cannot be implemented by a CVP lattice map. Companion matrices only implement multiplication by fixed elements; selector-based linearization reintroduces G13/G19 signed identities, while an l1-at-most-3 search is not a complete shell.

Proposal 7 is an unfrozen search framework rather than a construction: G31, G38, and flow features inhabit different coefficient spaces, and no linking map, metric normalization, eigenvalue floor, or iteration bound is given. A fixed-instance CEGIS optimum or dual would concern only its finite feature cone and cannot be promoted to an asymptotic theorem.
evidence: G13 verified an exact integral honest-affine-span collision annihilating every compatible linear syndrome, and G15 lifted it through every hierarchy level with zero residual. This directly blocks the linear digit-tree and sheaf-style claims absent a nonlinear emitted mechanism.

G19 found a zero-residual accepting flow with two negative coefficients and only 16 anchor excess. No supplied verifier shows that prefix or higher-chain metrics force this or all related splices to polynomial cost.

G31 passed one finite shell, but G32 exhibited compatible parity at exactly twice the one-copy cost and G37 proved an exact universal additive cut throughout its tested metric family. Thus equal-radius geometry alone has no verified composition law.

G38 and G14 are only fixed-shell bag passes; G15 shows that enlarged views can still admit zero-residual affine lifts. Neither supplies evidence for the proposed cosystolic or expander scaling claims.

G28 failed its adverse-versus-legal growth inequality, and G30 found an exact NO/YES seed isometry. These are direct warnings against inferring amplification from finite composition or multiplicative terminology.
No verifier evidence is supplied for any Generation-40 proposal. Every experimental outcome in the proposal file is predictive, and several experiments do not define a unique emitted instance.
next_experiment: None as written. Reopen only Proposal 7 after freezing one common coefficient space, explicit rational feature matrices and center, a scale normalization and positive eigenvalue floor yielding a complete coefficient shell, and a derived one/two-copy rule; then exact CEGIS may run to either a fully audited metric or a rational infeasibility/additivity certificate.
